boundary: This is an abstract group plus 24-root-action bridge. It does not supply a canonical W33 45-minimum to Schur 24-line bijection, and it imports the algebro-geometric identification of the root model with actual Schur lines from arXiv:2607.10090.

claims_used: 24 lines are labeled by the 24 D4 roots
32 triple points are unordered zero-sum root triples
half-stabilizer is W(D4):C3 with even triality
external_input.paper: Gerald Hohn, Automorphisms of a (24_4,32_3)-configuration on the Schur quartic, arXiv:2607.10090 (2026)

group_bridge.W33_identification: the companion three-way provenance certificate gives an explicit isomorphism from the W33 minimum-vector stabilizer to this root-parity F4 kernel

theorem: The 2026 Schur-quartic half-stabilizer W(D4):C3 is realized internally as the same F4 root-parity order-576 group already explicitly isomorphic to the W33 PSp(4,3) minimum-vector stabilizer; its faithful 24-root action preserves the exact (24_4,32_3) zero-sum incidence configuration.
